ctx.x: This is February 15th, 1979, and we're continuing the oral history with Nellie Lutcher, and we're going to do over part of this reel because we unfortunately developed some surface noise in there, and about when it started we were talking about the Southern Rhythm Boys, and you were telling me who was in the band, Nellie. You said Al Wilson? Okay, the personnel of the Southern Rhythm Boys.

The personnel consisted of a -- let's see, there were brothers, there were two brothers from Texas, Leo Williams and Eddie Williams. Leo played trombone. Eddie Williams played bass violin, and then we had Al Wilson, who was a marvelous saxophonist and arranger. And he taught me, I studied arranging under him. Yes, he had me arranging for the big Southern Rhythm Boys Orchestra for a while. And also in that orchestra was Alexis Rochan and Shelly LeMelle from New Orleans, and also a John Collins, I think that's the…
And both John and Lee played trumpet, is that right?
